releases.title: 版本更新
content: 新增：README 常见的块级 HTML 容器（居中的 div/center、details 折叠面板）可在预览视图中直接渲染并编辑，容器内按 Markdown 解析
新增：details 面板支持展开与收起，摘要行前显示三角指示器

新增：HTML 标题（h1–h6）与独立的
按网页效果渲染，保存时仍保留原标签
优化：段落内的单个换行按 GitHub/CommonMark 语义合并为空格，徽章等多行排版恢复为一行
优化：独占一段且未声明宽度的图片按原始尺寸显示，不再拉伸到整栏宽
修复：HTML 表格预览补充单元格边框与内边距，并修复预览高度只增不减导致的下方空白
contentEn: Added support for rendering and editing common block-level HTML containers from READMEs (centered div/center and collapsible details) directly in the preview view, with Markdown parsed inside the container.
Added expand and collapse controls to details panels, with a triangle indicator on the summary line.

Added HTML headings (h1–h6) and standalone
rendering; the original tags are preserved when saving.
Changed single line breaks inside paragraphs to collapse into spaces, matching GitHub/CommonMark, so multi-line badge rows render on one line.
Changed standalone images without an explicit width to render at their natural size instead of stretching to the full column width.
Fixed HTML table previews with cell borders and padding, and removed the blank area caused by preview height only ever growing.

linux.requirements: 主流 64 位 Linux 发行版
